description: A commercial process simulator for chemicals, polymers and life sciences. The AspenTech page describes Aspen Plus as a process simulator built on over 40 years of experience, with a physical properties database and integrated process modelling with economic, energy, safety and emissions analysis, and rigorous models for a wide range of processes. It is licensed commercially through the company, with pricing on request. Coverage is chemical and process plants worldwide. Caveats: it is proprietary, and the page read gives no pricing or licence terms. For simulation it models how chemical plants respond to changes in feed, utilities or equipment, feeding plant-level disruption and restart studies. A related catalogue record is Aspen HYSYS.
